name: option-sheet
title: Option Sheet
description: A sheet of single-choice rows that applies the picked option at once and closes: a sort order, a view. A bottom sheet on a phone, a centred panel from the large step.

files.content:
/* OptionSheet.css — .sd-optionsheet (Block)
   Arrangement only, and there is none to do. Drawer owns the sheet; ListBox owns the grouped box, the rows,
   their selected look (`indicator="check"`: brand ink, emphasized weight, trailing check) and the group
   headers. No tokens. */
